articles.title_en: Testing specification of distribution in stochastic frontier analysis
articles.abstract_en: Stochastic frontier analysis is regularly used in empirical studies to evaluate the productivity and efficiency of companies. A typical stochastic frontier model involves a parametric frontier subject to a composite error term consisting of an inefficiency and a random error. We develop new tests for specification of distribution of the inefficiency. We focus on simultaneous relaxation of two common assumptions: (1) parametric frontier which may lead to false conclusions when misspecified, and (2) homoscedasticity which can be easily violated when working with real data. While these two issues have been extensively studied in prior research exploring the estimation of a stochastic frontier and inefficiencies, they have not been properly addressed in the considered testing problem. We propose novel bootstrap and asymptotic distribution-free tests with neither parametric frontier nor homoscedasticity assumptions, in both cross-sectional and panel settings. Our tests are asymptotically consistent, simple to implement and widely applicable. Their powers against general fixed alternatives tend to one as sample size increases, and they can detect root-n order local alternatives. We demonstrate their efficacies through extensive simulation studies. When applied to a banking panel dataset, our tests provide sound justification for the commonly used exponential specification for banking data. The findings also show that a new parametric frontier model is more plausible than the conventional translog frontier.

articles.title_en: Testing equality of several distributions in separable metric spaces: A maximum mean discrepancy based approach
articles.title_cn: 在可分度量空间中检验多个分布的相等性：一种基于最大均值差异的方法
articles.abstract_en: A new test for equal distributions of several high-dimensional samples in separable metric spaces, with its test statistic constructed based on maximum mean discrepancy, is proposed and studied. The asymptotic null and alternative distributions of the test statistic are established under some mild conditions. The new test is implemented via a three-cumulant matched chi-square approximation with the associated approximation parameters consistently estimated from the data. A new data-adaptive Gaussian kernel width selection method is also suggested. Good performance of the new test is illustrated by intensive simulation studies and a real data example of Gini index curves.
articles.abstract_cn: 提出并研究了一种新的检验，用于在可分度量空间中检验多个高维样本的分布是否相等，其检验统计量基于最大均值差异构建。在温和条件下，建立了检验统计量的渐近零分布和备择分布。新检验通过三累积量匹配的卡方近似实现，相关近似参数从数据中一致估计。还提出了一种新的数据自适应高斯核宽度选择方法。通过密集的模拟研究和基尼指数曲线的真实数据示例，展示了新检验的良好性能。

articles.title_en: Asset splitting algorithm for ultrahigh dimensional portfolio selection and its theoretical property
articles.title_cn: 超高维投资组合选择的资产分割算法及其理论性质
articles.abstract_en: The presence of a huge number of assets poses challenges to classical portfolio selection algorithms. Constrained l1 minimization approaches have been proposed to directly estimate effective parameters in the optimal portfolio. Linear programming method and alternating direction method of multiplier (ADMM) algorithm is used to solve the corresponding minimization problems. However, these two algorithms may fail due to the limitations of computing time and computing memory when a huge number of assets are considered in the portfolio optimization. This article proposes an asset splitting ADMM (AS-ADMM for short), a parallel computing algorithm, to tackle such challenges, and establishes the convergence property of the new algorithm. Furthermore, we develop a new regularization method for estimating the effective parameters with the folded-concave penalty and establish its oracle property. The local linear approximation (LLA) algorithm is used to redirect the new method to a weighted l1 regularization method. We conduct simulation studies to investigate the advantage of the proposed algorithm and regularized model in solving the high dimensional portfolio selection problems. A real data example is also included to demonstrate the applicability of the proposed algorithms and regularization methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量资产的存在对经典的投资组合选择算法提出了挑战。已有研究提出约束的l1最小化方法，直接估计最优投资组合中的有效参数。线性规划方法和交替方向乘子法（ADMM）算法被用于求解相应的最小化问题。然而，当投资组合优化中考虑大量资产时，这两种算法可能因计算时间和计算内存的限制而失效。本文提出了一种资产分割ADMM（简称AS-ADMM）并行计算算法来应对这些挑战，并建立了新算法的收敛性。此外，我们开发了一种新的正则化方法，使用折叠凹惩罚估计有效参数，并建立了其oracle性质。局部线性近似（LLA）算法被用于将新方法转化为加权l1正则化方法。我们进行了模拟研究，以探讨所提出的算法和正则化模型在解决高维投资组合选择问题中的优势。还包含一个真实数据示例，以展示所提出的算法和正则化方法的适用性。

articles.title_en: A Multi-Kink quantile regression model with common structure for panel data analysis
articles.title_cn: 面板数据分析中具有共同结构的多拐点分位数回归模型
articles.abstract_en: Stimulated by the analysis of a data set on financial portfolio returns, we propose a multi-kink quantile regression (MKQR) model with latent homogeneous structure for panel data analysis. The proposed model accounts for both homogeneity and heterogeneity among individuals and parameters in panel data analysis. From statistical modeling point of view, it well balances the risk of misspecification and the model parsimony. From practical point of view, it is able to reveal not only the impacts of covariates in the global sense, but also individual attributes. An estimation procedure is presented to estimate both the unknown parameters and the latent homogeneous structure in the proposed model. Computational issues with the implementation of the estimation procedure are also discussed. Asymptotic theory of the estimators is established. It shows the necessity of taking into account both homogeneity and heterogeneity in panel data analysis. Monte Carlo simulation studies are conducted to demonstrate the finite sample performance of the proposed estimation and the risk of ignoring the homogeneity or heterogeneity among individuals. Finally, we apply the proposed model and the estimation procedure to the data set which stimulates this work and reveal some interesting findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 受金融投资组合收益数据集分析的启发，我们提出了一种用于面板数据分析的具有潜在同质结构的多拐点分位数回归（MKQR）模型。所提出的模型同时考虑了面板数据分析中个体间和参数间的同质性与异质性。从统计建模的角度来看，它很好地平衡了误设风险与模型简约性。从实践角度来看，它不仅能够揭示协变量在全局意义上的影响，还能揭示个体属性。我们提出了一种估计程序来估计所提出模型中的未知参数和潜在同质结构。还讨论了估计程序实现中的计算问题。建立了估计量的渐近理论。它显示了在面板数据分析中同时考虑同质性和异质性的必要性。进行了蒙特卡洛模拟研究，以证明所提出估计的有限样本性能以及忽略个体间同质性或异质性的风险。最后，我们将所提出的模型和估计程序应用于激发这项工作的数据集，并揭示了一些有趣的发现。

articles.title_en: Optimal covariance matrix estimation for high-dimensional noise in high-frequency data
articles.title_cn: 高频数据中高维噪声的最优协方差矩阵估计
articles.abstract_en: We consider high-dimensional measurement errors with high-frequency data. Our objective is on recovering the high-dimensional cross-sectional covariance matrix of the random errors with optimality. In this problem, not all components of the random vector are observed at the same time and the measurement errors are latent variables, leading to major challenges besides high data dimensionality. We propose a new covariance matrix estimator in this context with appropriate localization and thresholding, and then conduct a series of comprehensive theoretical investigations of the proposed estimator. By developing a new technical device integrating the high-frequency data feature with the conventional notion of α-mixing, our analysis successfully accommodates the challenging serial dependence in the measurement errors. Our theoretical analysis establishes the minimax optimal convergence rates associated with two commonly used loss functions; and we demonstrate with concrete cases when the proposed localized estimator with thresholding achieves the minimax optimal convergence rates. Considering that the variances and covariances can be small in reality, we conduct a second-order theoretical analysis that further disentangles the dominating bias in the estimator. A bias-corrected estimator is then proposed to ensure its practical finite sample performance. We also extensively analyze our estimator in the setting with jumps, and show that its performance is reasonably robust. We illustrate the promising empirical performance of the proposed estimator with extensive simulation studies and a real data analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有高频数据的高维测量误差。我们的目标是恢复随机误差的高维横截面协方差矩阵，并达到最优性。在此问题中，并非随机向量的所有分量同时被观测，且测量误差为潜在变量，这除了高数据维度外还带来了主要挑战。我们在此背景下提出了一种新的协方差矩阵估计器，采用适当的局部化和阈值化处理，并对所提出的估计器进行了一系列全面的理论研究。通过开发一种将高频数据特征与传统的α混合概念相结合的新技术工具，我们的分析成功适应了测量误差中具有挑战性的序列相关性。我们的理论分析建立了与两种常用损失函数相关的极小极大最优收敛速率；并通过具体案例展示了所提出的局部化阈值估计器何时达到极小极大最优收敛速率。考虑到现实中方差和协方差可能较小，我们进行了二阶理论分析，进一步厘清了估计器中的主导偏差。随后提出了一种偏差校正估计器，以确保其在实际中的有限样本性能。我们还在存在跳跃的情况下广泛分析了我们的估计器，并表明其性能相当稳健。我们通过广泛的模拟研究和真实数据分析展示了所提出估计器的良好实证性能。

articles.title_en: A generalized knockoff procedure for FDR control in structural change detection
articles.title_cn: 结构变化检测中FDR控制的一种广义knockoff方法
articles.abstract_en: Controlling false discovery rate (FDR) is crucial for variable selection, multiple testing, among other signal detection problems. In literature, there is certainly no shortage of FDR control strategies when selecting individual features, but the relevant works for structural change detection, such as profile analysis for piecewise constant coefficients and integration analysis with multiple data sources, are limited. In this paper, we propose a generalized knockoff procedure (GKnockoff) for FDR control under such problem settings. We prove that the GKnockoff possesses pairwise exchangeability, and is capable of controlling the exact FDR under finite sample sizes. We further explore GKnockoff under high dimensionality, by first introducing a new screening method to filter the high-dimensional potential structural changes. We adopt a data splitting technique to first reduce the dimensionality via screening and then conduct GKnockoff on the refined selection set. Furthermore, the powers of proposed methods are systematically studied. Numerical comparisons with other methods show the superior performance of GKnockoff, in terms of both FDR control and power. We also implement the proposed methods to analyze a macroeconomic dataset for detecting changes of driven effects of economic development on the secondary industry.
articles.abstract_cn: 控制错误发现率（FDR）对于变量选择、多重检验以及其他信号检测问题至关重要。在文献中，当选择单个特征时，FDR控制策略并不缺乏，但针对结构变化检测的相关工作，如分段常数系数的剖面分析和多数据源的整合分析，却十分有限。在本文中，我们提出了一种广义knockoff方法（GKnockoff），用于在此类问题设置下控制FDR。我们证明了GKnockoff具有成对可交换性，并能在有限样本量下控制精确的FDR。我们进一步在高维情况下探索GKnockoff，首先引入一种新的筛选方法来过滤高维潜在的结构变化。我们采用数据分割技术，先通过筛选降低维度，然后在精炼的选择集上执行GKnockoff。此外，系统地研究了所提出方法的功效。与其他方法的数值比较显示，GKnockoff在FDR控制和功效方面均表现出优越性能。我们还应用所提出的方法分析了一个宏观经济数据集，以检测经济发展对第二产业的驱动效应的变化。

articles.title_en: Time-varying minimum variance portfolio
articles.title_cn: 时变最小方差投资组合
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new time-varying minimum variance portfolio (TV-MVP) in a large investment universe of assets. Our method extends the existing literature on minimum variance portfolios by allowing for time-varying factor loadings, which facilitates the capture of the dynamics of the covariance structure of asset returns (and hence, the optimal investment strategy in a dynamic setting). We also use a shrinkage estimation method based on a quasi-likelihood function to regularize the residual covariances further. We establish the desired theoretical properties of proposed time-varying covariance and the optimal portfolio estimators under a more realistic heavy-tailed distribution. Specifically, we provide consistency of the optimal Sharpe ratio of the TV-MVP and the sharp risk consistency. Moreover, we offer a test of constant covariance structure and show the asymptotic distribution of the test statistic. Simulation and empirical studies suggest that the performance of the proposed TV-MVP is superior, in terms of estimation accuracy and out-of-sample Sharpe ratio, compared with that of other popular contemporary methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个大的资产投资领域中提出了一种新的时变最小方差投资组合（TV-MVP）。我们的方法通过允许时变的因子载荷，扩展了现有关于最小方差投资组合的文献，这有助于捕捉资产收益协方差结构的动态性（从而在动态环境中捕捉最优投资策略）。我们还使用基于拟似然函数的收缩估计方法进一步正则化残差协方差。我们在更现实的厚尾分布下建立了所提出的时变协方差和最优投资组合估计量的理想理论性质。具体而言，我们提供了TV-MVP的最优夏普比率的一致性和锐利风险一致性。此外，我们提供了常数协方差结构的检验，并展示了检验统计量的渐近分布。模拟和实证研究表明，与其他流行的当代方法相比，所提出的TV-MVP在估计精度和样本外夏普比率方面的表现更优。

articles.title_en: A latent class Cox model for heterogeneous time-to-event data
articles.title_cn: 异质性时间-事件数据的潜在类别Cox模型
articles.abstract_en: Credit risk plays a vital role in the era of digital finance and it is one of primary interests to identify customers with similar types of risk categories so that personalized financial services can be offered accordingly. Motivated by the bourgeoning need for default risk modeling in finance, we propose herein a latent class Cox model for heterogeneous time-to-event data. The proposed model naturally extends the Cox proportional hazards model to flexibly take into account the heterogeneity of covariate effects as often manifested in real data. Without a priori specification of the number of latent classes, it simultaneously incorporates the commonalities and disparities of individual customers’ risk behaviors and provides a more refined modeling technique than existing approaches. We further propose a penalized maximum likelihood approach to identify the number of latent classes and estimate the model parameters. A modified expectation–maximization algorithm is then developed for its numerical implementation. Simulation studies are conducted to assess the finite-sample performance of the proposed approach. Its illustration with a real credit card data set is also provided.
articles.abstract_cn: 信用风险在数字金融时代扮演着至关重要的角色，识别具有相似风险类别特征的客户以便相应地提供个性化金融服务是主要关注点之一。受金融领域违约风险建模日益增长的需求驱动，我们在此提出一种针对异质性时间-事件数据的潜在类别Cox模型。所提出的模型自然扩展了Cox比例风险模型，以灵活考虑协变量效应的异质性，这种异质性在真实数据中经常显现。无需预先指定潜在类别的数量，它同时整合了单个客户风险行为的共性和差异，并提供比现有方法更精细的建模技术。我们进一步提出一种惩罚最大似然方法来识别潜在类别的数量并估计模型参数。随后开发了一种修正的期望最大化算法用于数值实现。进行了模拟研究以评估所提出方法的有限样本性能。还提供了其在真实信用卡数据集上的应用说明。

articles.title_en: A post-screening diagnostic study for ultrahigh dimensional data
articles.title_cn: 超高维数据的筛选后诊断研究
articles.abstract_en: We propose a consistent lack-of-fit test to assess whether replacing the original ultrahigh dimensional covariates with a given number of linear combinations results in a loss of regression information. To attenuate the spurious correlations that may inflate type-I error rates in high dimensions, we suggest to randomly split the observations into two parts. In the first part, we screen out as many irrelevant covariates as possible. This screening step helps to reduce the ultrahigh dimensionality to a moderate scale. In the second part, we perform a lack-of-fit test for conditional independence in the context of sufficient dimension reduction. In case that some important covariates are missed with a non-ignorable probability in the first screening stage, we introduce a multiple splitting procedure. We further propose a new statistic to test for conditional independence, which is shown to be n-consistent under the null and root-n-consistent under the alternative. We develop a consistent bootstrap procedure to approximate the asymptotic null distribution. The performances of our proposal are evaluated through comprehensive simulations and an empirical analysis of GDP data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种一致的缺乏拟合检验，以评估用给定数量的线性组合替换原始超高维协变量是否会导致回归信息的损失。为了减弱在高维中可能膨胀第一类错误率的虚假相关性，我们建议将观测值随机分成两部分。在第一部分中，我们尽可能多地筛选出无关的协变量。这一筛选步骤有助于将超高维降至中等规模。在第二部分中，我们在充分降维的背景下对条件独立性进行缺乏拟合检验。如果在第一筛选阶段以不可忽略的概率遗漏了一些重要协变量，我们引入多重分割程序。我们进一步提出了一种新的统计量来检验条件独立性，该统计量在原假设下是n-相合的，在备择假设下是根号n-相合的。我们开发了一种一致的bootstrap程序来近似渐近零分布。我们通过综合模拟和GDP数据的实证分析评估了我们提出的方法的性能。

articles.title_en: Mixed membership estimation for social networks
articles.title_cn: 社交网络的混合成员估计
articles.abstract_en: In economics and social science, network data are regularly observed, and a thorough understanding of the network community structure facilitates the comprehension of economic patterns and activities. Consider an undirected network with n nodes and K communities. We model the network using the Degree-Corrected Mixed-Membership (DCMM) model, where for each node i=1,2,…,n, there exists a membership vector πi=(πi(1),πi(2),…,πi(K))′, where πi(k) is the weight that node i puts on community k, 1≤k≤K. In comparison to the well-known stochastic block model (SBM), the DCMM permits both severe degree heterogeneity and mixed memberships, making it more realistic and general. We present an efficient approach, Mixed-SCORE, for estimating the mixed membership vectors of all nodes and the other DCMM parameters. This approach is inspired by the discovery of a delicate simplex structure in the spectral domain. We derive explicit error rates for the Mixed-SCORE algorithm and demonstrate that it is rate-optimal over a broad parameter space. Our findings provide a novel statistical tool for network community analysis, which can be used to understand network formations, extract nodal features, identify unobserved covariates in dyadic regressions, and estimate peer effects. We applied Mixed-SCORE to a political blog network, two trade networks, a co-authorship network, and a citee network, and obtained interpretable results.
articles.abstract_cn: 在经济学和社会科学中，网络数据经常被观测到，对网络社区结构的深入理解有助于理解经济模式和活动。考虑一个具有n个节点和K个社区的无向网络。我们使用度修正混合成员（DCMM）模型对网络进行建模，其中对于每个节点i=1,2,…,n，存在一个成员向量πi=(πi(1),πi(2),…,πi(K))′，其中πi(k)是节点i赋予社区k的权重，1≤k≤K。与众所周知的随机块模型（SBM）相比，DCMM允许严重的度异质性和混合成员，使其更加现实和通用。我们提出了一种高效的方法，即Mixed-SCORE，用于估计所有节点的混合成员向量以及其他DCMM参数。该方法受到谱域中精细单纯形结构发现的启发。我们推导了Mixed-SCORE算法的显式误差率，并证明其在广泛的参数空间上具有速率最优性。我们的发现为网络社区分析提供了一种新颖的统计工具，可用于理解网络形成、提取节点特征、识别二元回归中未观测的协变量以及估计同伴效应。我们将Mixed-SCORE应用于一个政治博客网络、两个贸易网络、一个合著网络和一个被引网络，并获得了可解释的结果。

articles.title_en: An autocovariance-based learning framework for high-dimensional functional time series
articles.title_cn: 基于自协方差的高维函数型时间序列学习框架
articles.abstract_en: Many scientific and economic applications involve the statistical learning of high-dimensional functional time series, where the number of functional variables is comparable to, or even greater than, the number of serially dependent functional observations. In this paper, we model observed functional time series, which are subject to errors in the sense that each functional datum arises as the sum of two uncorrelated components, one dynamic and one white noise. Motivated from the fact that the autocovariance function of observed functional time series automatically filters out the noise term, we propose a three-step framework by first performing autocovariance-based dimension reduction, then formulating a novel autocovariance-based block regularized minimum distance estimation to produce block sparse estimates, and based on which obtaining the final functional sparse estimates. We investigate theoretical properties of the proposed estimators, and illustrate the proposed estimation procedure with the corresponding convergence analysis via three sparse high-dimensional functional time series models. We demonstrate via both simulated and real datasets that our proposed estimators significantly outperform their competitors.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多科学和经济应用涉及高维函数型时间序列的统计学习，其中函数型变量的数量与序列相关的函数型观测数量相当，甚至更大。在本文中，我们对观测到的函数型时间序列进行建模，这些序列存在误差，即每个函数型数据点由两个不相关的分量之和构成，一个是动态分量，另一个是白噪声。鉴于观测到的函数型时间序列的自协方差函数自动滤除噪声项这一事实，我们提出了一个三步框架：首先进行基于自协方差的降维，然后构建一种新颖的基于自协方差的块正则化最小距离估计以产生块稀疏估计，并在此基础上获得最终的函数型稀疏估计。我们研究了所提出估计量的理论性质，并通过三个稀疏高维函数型时间序列模型，结合相应的收敛性分析，阐述了所提出的估计程序。我们通过模拟和真实数据集证明，我们提出的估计量显著优于其竞争对手。

articles.title_en: Mining the factor zoo: Estimation of latent factor models with sufficient proxies
articles.title_cn: 挖掘因子动物园：利用充分代理变量估计潜在因子模型
articles.abstract_en: Latent factor model estimation typically relies on either using domain knowledge to manually pick several observed covariates as factor proxies, or purely conducting multivariate analysis such as principal component analysis. However, the former approach may suffer from the bias while the latter cannot incorporate additional information. We propose to bridge these two approaches while allowing the number of factor proxies to diverge, and hence make the latent factor model estimation robust, flexible, and statistically more accurate. As a bonus, the number of factors is also allowed to grow. At the heart of our method is a penalized reduced rank regression to combine information. To further deal with heavy-tailed data, a computationally attractive penalized robust reduced rank regression method is proposed. We establish faster rates of convergence compared with the benchmark. Extensive simulations and real examples are used to illustrate the advantages.
articles.abstract_cn: 潜在因子模型的估计通常依赖于两种方法：一是利用领域知识手动挑选若干观测协变量作为因子代理，二是纯粹进行主成分分析等多变量分析。然而，前者可能遭受偏差，而后者无法纳入额外信息。我们提出将这两种方法桥接起来，同时允许因子代理的数量发散，从而使潜在因子模型的估计更加稳健、灵活且统计上更精确。作为额外收益，因子数量也被允许增长。我们方法的核心是结合信息的惩罚降秩回归。为进一步处理重尾数据，提出了一种计算上具有吸引力的惩罚稳健降秩回归方法。我们建立了比基准更快的收敛速度。通过大量模拟和实际案例来说明其优势。

articles.title_en: Robustifying Markowitz
articles.title_cn: 稳健化马科维茨
articles.abstract_en: Markowitz mean–variance portfolios with sample mean and covariance as input parameters feature numerous issues in practice. They perform poorly out of sample due to estimation error, they experience extreme weights together with high sensitivity to change in input parameters. The heavy-tail characteristics of financial time series are in fact the cause for these erratic fluctuations of weights that consequently create substantial transaction costs. In robustifying the weights we present a toolbox for stabilizing costs and weights for global minimum Markowitz portfolios. Utilizing a projected gradient descent (PGD) technique, we avoid the estimation and inversion of the covariance operator as a whole and concentrate on robust estimation of the gradient descent increment. Using modern tools of robust statistics we construct a computationally efficient estimator with almost Gaussian properties based on median-of-means uniformly over weights. This robustified Markowitz approach is confirmed by empirical studies on equity markets. We demonstrate that robustified portfolios reach the lowest turnover compared to shrinkage-based and constrained portfolios while preserving or slightly improving out-of-sample performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 以样本均值和协方差作为输入参数的马科维茨均值-方差组合在实践中存在诸多问题。由于估计误差，它们在样本外表现不佳，同时经历极端权重以及对输入参数变化的高度敏感性。金融时间序列的厚尾特征实际上是导致权重剧烈波动并因此产生大量交易成本的原因。在稳健化权重方面，我们提供了一个工具箱，用于稳定全局最小马科维茨组合的成本和权重。利用投影梯度下降（PGD）技术，我们避免了对协方差算子的整体估计和求逆，并专注于对梯度下降增量的稳健估计。利用现代稳健统计工具，我们构建了一个计算效率高的估计器，该估计器基于权重的均值中位数，具有近似高斯性质。这种稳健化的马科维茨方法通过股票市场的实证研究得到证实。我们证明，与基于收缩和约束的组合相比，稳健化组合在保持或略微改善样本外表现的同时，达到了最低的换手率。

articles.title_en: Spherical autoregressive models, with application to distributional and compositional time series
articles.title_cn: 球面自回归模型及其在分布和成分时间序列中的应用
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a new class of autoregressive models for spherical time series. The dimension of the spheres on which the observations of the time series are situated may be finite-dimensional or infinite-dimensional, where in the latter case we consider the Hilbert sphere. Spherical time series arise in various settings. We focus here on distributional and compositional time series. Applying a square root transformation to the densities of the observations of a distributional time series maps the distributional observations to the Hilbert sphere, equipped with the Fisher–Rao metric. Likewise, applying a square root transformation to the components of the observations of a compositional time series maps the compositional observations to a finite-dimensional sphere, equipped with the geodesic metric on spheres. The challenge in modeling such time series lies in the intrinsic non-linearity of spheres and Hilbert spheres, where conventional arithmetic operations such as addition or scalar multiplication are no longer available. To address this difficulty, we consider rotation operators to map observations on the sphere. Specifically, we introduce a class of skew-symmetric operators such that the associated exponential operators are rotation operators that for each given pair of points on the sphere map the first point of the pair to the second point of the pair. We exploit the fact that the space of skew-symmetric operators is Hilbertian to develop autoregressive modeling of geometric differences that correspond to rotations of spherical and distributional time series. Differences expressed in terms of rotations can be taken between the Fréchet mean and the observations or between consecutive observations of the time series. We derive theoretical properties of the ensuing autoregressive models and showcase these approaches with several motivating data. These include a time series of yearly observations of bivariate distributions of the minimum/maximum temperatures for a period of 120 days during each summer for the years 1990-2018 at Los Angeles (LAX) and John F. Kennedy (JFK) international airports. A second data application concerns a compositional time series with annual observations of compositions of energy sources for power generation in the U.S..
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一类新的球面时间序列自回归模型。时间序列观测值所在的球面维度可以是有限维或无限维，在无限维情形下我们考虑希尔伯特球面。球面时间序列出现在多种情境中。这里我们关注分布和成分时间序列。对分布时间序列的观测密度应用平方根变换，可将分布观测映射到配备Fisher–Rao度量的希尔伯特球面。同样，对成分时间序列的观测分量应用平方根变换，可将成分观测映射到配备球面测地度量的有限维球面。建模此类时间序列的挑战在于球面和希尔伯特球面固有的非线性，其中加法或标量乘法等常规算术运算不再可用。为解决这一困难，我们考虑旋转算子将观测映射到球面上。具体而言，我们引入一类斜对称算子，使得相应的指数算子为旋转算子，对于球面上给定的每对点，将该对中的第一个点映射到第二个点。我们利用斜对称算子空间是希尔伯特空间这一事实，发展了几何差异的自回归建模，这些差异对应于球面和分布时间序列的旋转。以旋转表示的差异可以在Fréchet均值与观测之间或时间序列的连续观测之间取得。我们推导了由此产生的自回归模型的理论性质，并用几个激励性数据展示了这些方法。这些数据包括洛杉矶（LAX）和约翰·肯尼迪（JFK）国际机场每年夏季120天期间最低/最高温度二元分布的年度观测时间序列，年份为1990-2018。第二个数据应用涉及美国发电能源来源成分的年度观测成分时间序列。

articles.title_en: The nonparametric Box–Cox model for high-dimensional regression analysis
articles.title_cn: 非参数Box-Cox模型用于高维回归分析
articles.abstract_en: The mainstream theory for high-dimensional regression assumes that the underlying true model is a low-dimensional linear regression model. On the other hand, a standard technique in regression analysis, even in the traditional low-dimensional setting, is to employ the Box–Cox transformation for reducing anomalies such as non-additivity and heteroscedasticity in linear regression. In this paper, we propose a new high-dimensional regression method based on a nonparametric Box–Cox model with an unspecified monotone transformation function. Model fitting and computation become much more challenging than the usual penalized regression method, and a two-step method is proposed for the estimation of this model in high-dimensional settings. First, we propose a novel technique called composite probit regression (CPR) and use the folded concave penalized CPR for estimating the regression parameters. The strong oracle property of the estimator is established without knowing the nonparametric transformation function. Next, the nonparametric function is estimated by conducting univariate monotone regression. The computation is done efficiently by using a coordinate-majorization-descent algorithm. Extensive simulation studies show that the proposed method performs well in various settings. Our analysis of the supermarket data demonstrates the superior performance of the proposed method over the standard high-dimensional regression method.
articles.abstract_cn: 高维回归的主流理论假设潜在的真实模型是低维线性回归模型。另一方面，回归分析中的标准技术，即使在传统的低维设置中，也采用Box-Cox变换来减少线性回归中的非可加性和异方差性等异常。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的高维回归方法，基于具有未指定单调变换函数的非参数Box-Cox模型。模型拟合和计算比通常的惩罚回归方法更具挑战性，我们提出了一种两步方法来估计高维设置中的该模型。首先，我们提出了一种称为复合概率回归（CPR）的新技术，并使用折叠凹惩罚CPR来估计回归参数。在不知道非参数变换函数的情况下，建立了估计量的强oracle性质。接下来，通过进行单变量单调回归来估计非参数函数。通过使用坐标-主化-下降算法高效地完成计算。广泛的模拟研究表明，所提出的方法在各种设置下表现良好。我们对超市数据的分析证明了所提出的方法优于标准高维回归方法的优越性能。

articles.title_en: High frequency market making: The role of speed
articles.title_cn: 高频做市：速度的作用
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model where a strategic high frequency market maker exploits his speed and informational advantages to place quotes that interact with the market orders of low frequency traders. We characterize the optimal market making policy and the equilibrium that results. The model has testable implications regarding the impact of speed on the provision of liquidity. We test these implications by taking advantage of a natural experiment on the NYSE American stock exchange, which implemented an intentional delay in 2017 then removed it in 2019. We find broad agreement between the empirical evidence and the implications of the model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个模型，其中战略性的高频做市商利用其速度和信息优势来放置报价，与低频交易者的市价单互动。我们刻画了最优做市策略及由此产生的均衡。该模型对速度对流动性供给的影响具有可检验的含义。我们利用纽约证券交易所美国股票交易所的一个自然实验来检验这些含义，该交易所于2017年实施了有意延迟，然后在2019年取消了延迟。我们发现实证证据与模型的含义之间存在广泛的一致性。

articles.title_en: Inferential theory for generalized dynamic factor models
articles.title_cn: 广义动态因子模型的推断理论
articles.abstract_en: We provide the asymptotic distributional theory for the so-called General or Generalized Dynamic Factor Model (GDFM), laying the foundations for an inferential approach in the GDFM analysis of high-dimensional time series. By exploiting the duality between common shocks and dynamic loadings, we derive the asymptotic distribution and associated standard errors for a class of estimators for common shocks, dynamic loadings, common components, and impulse response functions. We present an empirical application aimed at constructing a “core” inflation indicator for the U.S. economy, which demonstrates the superiority of the GDFM-based indicator over the most common approaches, particularly the one based on Principal Components.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为所谓的广义或一般动态因子模型（GDFM）提供了渐近分布理论，为高维时间序列的GDFM分析中的推断方法奠定了基础。通过利用共同冲击与动态载荷之间的对偶性，我们推导出了一类估计量的渐近分布及相关标准误，这些估计量用于共同冲击、动态载荷、共同成分和脉冲响应函数。我们提出了一个旨在为美国经济构建“核心”通胀指标的实证应用，该应用展示了基于GDFM的指标相对于最常见方法（尤其是基于主成分的方法）的优越性。

articles.title_en: Power enhancement for testing multi-factor asset pricing models via Fisher’s method
articles.title_cn: 基于Fisher方法的乘数因子资产定价模型检验的功效增强
articles.abstract_en: Testing multi-factor asset pricing models is instrumental for asset pricing theory and practice. However, due to the accumulation of errors in estimating high-dimensional parameters, traditional quadratic-form tests such as the Wald test perform poorly against the sparse alternative hypothesis, i.e., a few mispriced assets. Fan et al. (2015b) introduced a powerful testing procedure by adding a power enhancement component to the Wald test statistic and proved power enhancement properties. To provide an alternative to their methodology, we first instantiate the power enhancement component by introducing a new maximum-form test statistic and then study the asymptotic joint distribution of the Wald test statistic and the maximum test statistic. We prove that these two test statistics are asymptotically independent. Given their asymptotic independence, we propose a new power-enhanced testing procedure to combine their respective power based on Fisher’s method (Fisher, 1925). Theoretically, we prove that the new power-enhanced test retains the desired nominal significance level and achieves asymptotically consistent power against more general alternatives. Furthermore, we demonstrate the finite-sample performance of our proposed power-enhanced test in both simulation studies and an empirical study of testing market efficiency using asset returns of the Russel-2000 portfolio.
articles.abstract_cn: 检验乘数因子资产定价模型对资产定价理论和实践具有重要意义。然而，由于高维参数估计中误差的累积，传统的二次型检验（如Wald检验）在稀疏备择假设（即少数错误定价资产）下表现不佳。Fan等人（2015b）通过在Wald检验统计量中加入功效增强成分，提出了一种强有力的检验程序，并证明了功效增强性质。为了提供他们方法的替代方案，我们首先通过引入新的最大值形式检验统计量来实例化功效增强成分，然后研究Wald检验统计量与最大值检验统计量的渐近联合分布。我们证明了这两个检验统计量是渐近独立的。鉴于它们的渐近独立性，我们提出了一种新的功效增强检验程序，基于Fisher方法（Fisher, 1925）结合它们各自的功效。理论上，我们证明了新的功效增强检验保持了期望的名义显著性水平，并在更一般的备择假设下实现了渐近一致功效。此外，我们通过模拟研究和基于Russel-2000投资组合资产收益的市场效率实证研究，展示了我们提出的功效增强检验的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: Retire: Robust expectile regression in high dimensions
articles.title_cn: 退休：高维数据中的稳健期望回归
articles.abstract_en: High-dimensional data can often display heterogeneity due to heteroscedastic variance or inhomogeneous covariate effects. Penalized quantile and expectile regression methods offer useful tools to detect heteroscedasticity in high-dimensional data. The former is computationally challenging due to the non-smooth nature of the check loss, and the latter is sensitive to heavy-tailed error distributions. In this paper, we propose and study (penalized) robust expectile regression (retire), with a focus on iteratively reweighted ℓ1-penalization which reduces the estimation bias from ℓ1-penalization and leads to oracle properties. Theoretically, we establish the statistical properties of the retire estimator under two regimes: (i) low-dimensional regime in which d≪n; (ii) high-dimensional regime in which s≪n≪d with s denoting the number of significant predictors. In the high-dimensional setting, we thoroughly analyze the statistical properties of the solution path of iteratively reweighted ℓ1-penalized retire estimation, adapted from the local linear approximation algorithm for folded-concave regularization. Under a mild minimum signal strength condition, we demonstrate that with as few as log(logd) iterations, the final iterate of our proposed approach achieves the oracle convergence rate. At each iteration, we solve the weighted ℓ1-penalized convex program using a semismooth Newton coordinate descent algorithm. Numerical studies demonstrate the promising performance of the proposed procedure in comparison to both non-robust and quantile regression based alternatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 高维数据常常因异方差性或协变量效应不均匀而表现出异质性。惩罚分位数和期望回归方法为检测高维数据中的异方差性提供了有用工具。前者由于检查损失的非光滑性而计算上具有挑战性，后者则对重尾误差分布敏感。在本文中，我们提出并研究了（惩罚）稳健期望回归（retire），重点关注迭代重加权ℓ1-惩罚，这减少了ℓ1-惩罚的估计偏差并导致oracle性质。理论上，我们在两种机制下建立了retire估计量的统计性质：（i）低维机制，其中d≪n；（ii）高维机制，其中s≪n≪d，其中s表示显著预测因子的数量。在高维设置中，我们彻底分析了迭代重加权ℓ1-惩罚retire估计解路径的统计性质，该估计改编自用于折叠凹正则化的局部线性近似算法。在温和的最小信号强度条件下，我们证明只需log(logd)次迭代，我们提出的方法的最终迭代即可达到oracle收敛速度。在每次迭代中，我们使用半光滑牛顿坐标下降算法求解加权ℓ1-惩罚凸规划。数值研究证明了所提出程序相对于非稳健和基于分位数回归的替代方法的良好性能。

articles.title_en: Inference on the best policies with many covariates
articles.title_cn: 多协变量下最优政策的推断
articles.abstract_en: Understanding the impact of the most effective policies or treatments on a response variable of interest is desirable in many empirical works in economics, statistics and other disciplines. Due to the widespread winner’s curse phenomenon, conventional statistical inference assuming that the top policies are chosen independent of the random sample may lead to overly optimistic evaluations of the best policies. In recent years, given the increased availability of large datasets, such an issue can be further complicated when researchers include many covariates to estimate the policy or treatment effects in an attempt to control for potential confounders. In this manuscript, to simultaneously address the above-mentioned issues, we propose a resampling-based procedure that not only lifts the winner’s curse in evaluating the best policies observed in a random sample, but also is robust to the presence of many covariates. The proposed inference procedure yields accurate point estimates and valid frequentist confidence intervals that achieve the exact nominal level as the sample size goes to infinity for multiple best policy effect sizes. We illustrate the finite-sample performance of our approach through Monte Carlo experiments and two empirical studies, evaluating the most effective policies in charitable giving and the most beneficial group of workers in the National Supported Work program.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多经济学、统计学及其他学科的实证研究中，了解最有效的政策或处理对感兴趣响应变量的影响是可取的。由于广泛的赢家诅咒现象，假设最优政策独立于随机样本选择的传统统计推断可能导致对最优政策的评估过于乐观。近年来，随着大型数据集可用性的增加，当研究人员纳入许多协变量来估计政策或处理效应以试图控制潜在混杂因素时，这一问题可能变得更加复杂。在本手稿中，为了同时解决上述问题，我们提出了一种基于重抽样的程序，该程序不仅消除了评估随机样本中观察到的最优政策时的赢家诅咒，而且对许多协变量的存在具有稳健性。所提出的推断程序能够产生准确的点估计和有效的频率学置信区间，在样本量趋于无穷大时，对于多个最优政策效应量，这些置信区间达到精确的名义水平。我们通过蒙特卡洛实验和两项实证研究（评估慈善捐赠中最有效的政策和国家支持工作计划中最有益的工人群体）来说明我们方法的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: Bipartite network influence analysis of a two-mode network
articles.title_cn: 双模网络的二分网络影响力分析
articles.abstract_en: A two-mode network contains two types of nodes, and edges exist only between any two nodes that are associated with different entities. Owing to the network connections (i.e., edges) between the two types of network nodes, nodal responses are unlikely to be independently and identically distributed, resulting in possible nodal heterogeneity across the two types of nodes. This study proposes a novel bipartite network influence model (BNIM) to evaluate nodal heterogeneity from the perspective of nodal influence. To make the model estimable, we parameterize the influence indices with a set of nodal attributes through a prespecified link function, and employ the quasi-maximum likelihood approach to estimate the unknown parameters. Score tests are presented to examine the heterogeneity of nodal influences across the two types of nodes. To assess the adequacy of the link function, we carry out a quasi-likelihood ratio test and establish its asymptotic properties under the appropriate conditions. Simulation studies and the real data analysis of a fund-stock network are studied to assess the finite-sample performance of BNIM.
articles.abstract_cn: 双模网络包含两类节点，且边仅存在于与不同实体相关联的任意两个节点之间。由于两类网络节点之间的网络连接（即边），节点响应不太可能独立同分布，从而导致两类节点之间可能存在节点异质性。本研究提出了一种新颖的二分网络影响力模型（BNIM），从节点影响力的角度评估节点异质性。为使模型可估计，我们通过预设的连接函数将影响力指数参数化为节点属性的函数，并采用拟极大似然方法估计未知参数。提出得分检验以检验两类节点之间节点影响力的异质性。为评估连接函数的充分性，我们进行了拟似然比检验，并在适当条件下建立了其渐近性质。通过模拟研究和基金-股票网络的真实数据分析来评估BNIM的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: Dynamic modeling for multivariate functional and longitudinal data
articles.title_cn: 多元函数型与纵向数据的动态建模
articles.abstract_en: Dynamic interactions among several stochastic processes are common in many scientific fields. It is crucial to model these interactions to understand the dynamic relationship of the corresponding multivariate processes with their derivatives and to improve predictions. In reality, full observations of the multivariate processes are not feasible as measurements can only be taken at discrete locations or time points, and often only sparingly and intermittently in longitudinal studies. This results in multivariate longitudinal data that are measured at different times for different subjects. We propose a time-dynamic model to handle multivariate longitudinal data by modeling the derivatives of multivariate processes using the values of these processes. Starting with a linear concurrent model, we develop methods to estimate the regression coefficient functions, which can accommodate irregularly measured longitudinal data that are possibly contaminated with noise. Our approach can also be applied to settings when the observational times are the same for all subjects. We establish the convergence rates of our estimators with phase transitions and further illustrate our model through a simulation study and a real data application.
articles.abstract_cn: 多个随机过程之间的动态交互在许多科学领域都很常见。对这些交互进行建模对于理解相应多元过程及其导数之间的动态关系以及改进预测至关重要。实际上，由于测量只能在离散位置或时间点进行，并且通常在纵向研究中仅稀疏且间歇地进行，因此无法对多元过程进行完整观测。这导致了在不同时间对不同受试者测量的多元纵向数据。我们提出了一种时间动态模型，通过使用这些过程的值对多元过程的导数进行建模来处理多元纵向数据。从线性并发模型开始，我们开发了估计回归系数函数的方法，该方法可以适应可能受噪声污染的不规则测量的纵向数据。我们的方法也可以应用于所有受试者观测时间相同的情况。我们建立了具有相变的估计量的收敛速度，并通过模拟研究和实际数据应用进一步说明了我们的模型。

articles.title_en: Volatility prediction comparison via robust volatility proxies: An empirical deviation perspective
articles.title_cn: 基于稳健波动率代理的波动率预测比较：一个经验偏差视角
articles.abstract_en: Volatility forecasting is crucial to risk management and portfolio construction. One particular challenge of assessing volatility forecasts is how to construct a robust proxy for the unknown true volatility. In this work, we show that the empirical loss comparison between two volatility predictors hinges on the deviation of the volatility proxy from the true volatility. We then establish non-asymptotic deviation bounds for three robust volatility proxies, two of which are based on clipped data, and the third of which is based on exponentially weighted Huber loss minimization. In particular, in order for the Huber approach to adapt to non-stationary financial returns, we propose to solve a tuning-free weighted Huber loss minimization problem to jointly estimate the volatility and the optimal robustification parameter at each time point. We then inflate this robustification parameter and use it to update the volatility proxy to achieve optimal balance between the bias and variance of the global empirical loss. We also extend this Huber method to construct volatility predictors. Finally, we exploit the proposed robust volatility proxy to compare different volatility predictors on the Bitcoin market data and calibrated synthetic data. It turns out that when the sample size is limited, applying the robust volatility proxy gives more consistent and stable evaluation of volatility forecasts.
articles.abstract_cn: 波动率预测对风险管理和投资组合构建至关重要。评估波动率预测的一个特殊挑战是如何为未知的真实波动率构建一个稳健的代理。在这项工作中，我们表明两个波动率预测器之间的经验损失比较取决于波动率代理与真实波动率的偏差。然后，我们为三个稳健波动率代理建立了非渐近偏差界，其中两个基于截断数据，第三个基于指数加权Huber损失最小化。特别是，为了使Huber方法适应非平稳的金融收益，我们提出求解一个无调参的加权Huber损失最小化问题，以在每个时间点联合估计波动率和最优稳健化参数。然后，我们放大该稳健化参数，并用它来更新波动率代理，以实现全局经验损失的偏差和方差之间的最优平衡。我们还将此Huber方法扩展到构建波动率预测器。最后，我们利用所提出的稳健波动率代理在比特币市场数据和校准的合成数据上比较不同的波动率预测器。结果表明，当样本量有限时，应用稳健波动率代理能对波动率预测给出更一致和稳定的评估。

articles.title_en: Reprint: Statistical inference for linear mediation models with high-dimensional mediators and application to studying stock reaction to COVID-19 pandemic
articles.title_cn: 转载：高维中介变量的线性中介模型统计推断及其在股票对COVID-19疫情反应研究中的应用
articles.abstract_en: Mediation analysis draws increasing attention in many research areas such as economics, finance and social sciences. In this paper, we propose new statistical inference procedures for high dimensional mediation models, in which both the outcome model and the mediator model are linear with high dimensional mediators. Traditional procedures for mediation analysis cannot be used to make statistical inference for high dimensional linear mediation models due to high-dimensionality of the mediators. We propose an estimation procedure for the indirect effects of the models via a partially penalized least squares method, and further establish its theoretical properties. We further develop a partially penalized Wald test on the indirect effects, and prove that the proposed test has a χ2 limiting null distribution. We also propose an F-type test for direct effects and show that the proposed test asymptotically follows a χ2-distribution under null hypothesis and a noncentral χ2-distribution under local alternatives. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to examine the finite sample performance of the proposed tests and compare their performance with existing ones. We further apply the newly proposed statistical inference procedures to study stock reaction to COVID-19 pandemic via an empirical analysis of studying the mediation effects of financial metrics that bridge company’s sector and stock return.
articles.abstract_cn: 中介分析在经济学、金融学和社会科学等许多研究领域日益受到关注。本文针对高维中介模型提出了新的统计推断方法，其中结果模型和中介模型均为具有高维中介变量的线性模型。由于中介变量的高维性，传统的中介分析程序无法用于高维线性中介模型的统计推断。我们通过部分惩罚最小二乘法提出了模型间接效应的估计程序，并进一步建立了其理论性质。我们还开发了针对间接效应的部分惩罚Wald检验，并证明所提出的检验具有χ2极限零分布。我们还提出了针对直接效应的F型检验，并证明所提出的检验在原假设下渐近服从χ2分布，在局部备择假设下服从非中心χ2分布。进行了蒙特卡洛模拟以检验所提出检验的有限样本性能，并与现有检验进行比较。我们进一步将新提出的统计推断程序应用于研究股票对COVID-19疫情的反应，通过实证分析研究连接公司行业与股票收益的财务指标的中介效应。

articles.title_en: Reprint: Hypothesis testing on high dimensional quantile regression
articles.title_cn: 转载：高维分位数回归的假设检验
articles.abstract_en: Quantile regression has been an important analytical tool in econometrics since it was proposed in 1970s. Many advantages make it still popular in the era of big data. This paper focuses on the testing problems of high-dimensional quantile regression, supplementing to robust methods in the literature of high-dimensional hypothesis testing. We first construct a new test statistic based on the quantile regression score function. The new test statistic avoids the inverse operation of the covariance matrix, and hence becomes applicable to high-dimensional or even ultrahigh-dimensional settings. The proposed method retains robustness for non-Gaussian and heavy-tailed distributions. We then derive the limiting distributions of the proposed test statistic under both the null and the alternative hypotheses. We further investigate the case where the design matrix follows an elliptical distribution. We examined the finite sample performance of our proposed method through Monte Carlo simulations. The numerical comparisons exhibit that our proposed tests outperform some existing methods in terms of controlling Type I error rate and power, when the data deviate from the Gaussian assumptions or are heavy-tailed. We illustrate our proposed high-dimensional quantile testing in financial econometrics, through an empirical analysis of Chinese stock market data.
articles.abstract_cn: 分位数回归自1970年提出以来，一直是计量经济学中的重要分析工具。其诸多优势使其在大数据时代依然流行。本文关注高维分位数回归的检验问题，补充了高维假设检验文献中的稳健方法。我们首先基于分位数回归得分函数构建了一个新的检验统计量。该新统计量避免了协方差矩阵的逆运算，因此适用于高维甚至超高维设定。所提方法对非高斯和重尾分布保持稳健性。然后，我们推导了所提统计量在原假设和备择假设下的极限分布。我们进一步研究了设计矩阵服从椭圆分布的情形。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟检验了所提方法的有限样本性能。数值比较表明，当数据偏离高斯假设或为重尾时，我们提出的检验在控制第一类错误率和功效方面优于一些现有方法。我们通过中国股票市场数据的实证分析，说明了所提出的高维分位数检验在金融计量经济学中的应用。

articles.title_en: Stock co-jump networks
articles.title_cn: 股票共同跳跃网络
articles.abstract_en: We propose a Degree-Corrected Block Model with Dependent Multivariate Poisson edges (DCBM-DMP) to study stock co-jump dependence. To estimate the community structure, we extend the SCORE algorithm in Jin (2015) and develop a Spectral Clustering On Ratios-of-Eigenvectors for networks with Dependent Multivariate Poisson edges (SCORE-DMP) algorithm. We prove that SCORE-DMP enjoys strong consistency in community detection. Empirically, using high-frequency data of S&P 500 constituents, we construct two co-jump networks according to whether the market jumps and find that they exhibit different community features than GICS. We further show that the co-jump networks help in stock return prediction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种具有依赖多元泊松边的度校正块模型（DCBM-DMP）来研究股票共同跳跃依赖性。为了估计社区结构，我们扩展了Jin（2015）中的SCORE算法，并开发了一种针对具有依赖多元泊松边的网络的谱聚类比率特征向量算法（SCORE-DMP）。我们证明了SCORE-DMP在社区检测中具有强一致性。实证上，使用标普500成分股的高频数据，我们根据市场是否跳跃构建了两个共同跳跃网络，并发现它们表现出与GICS不同的社区特征。我们进一步表明，共同跳跃网络有助于股票收益预测。

articles.title_en: Realized regression with asynchronous and noisy high frequency and high dimensional data
articles.title_cn: 异步且含噪声的高频高维数据实现回归
articles.abstract_en: We develop regression for high frequency data. This regression is novel in that it can be for both fixed and increasing dimension. Also, the data may have microstructure noise, and observations (trades, or quotes) can be asynchronous, (i.e., the observations do not need to be synchronized across dimensions). As is customary for high-frequency inference methods, we refer to our method as “realized” regression.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们针对高频数据开发了回归方法。该回归方法的新颖之处在于它既适用于固定维数也适用于递增维数。此外，数据可能存在微观结构噪声，且观测值（交易或报价）可以是异步的（即，观测值不需要在各维度之间同步）。按照高频推断方法的惯例，我们将我们的方法称为“实现”回归。
